pr_title: sig/execution: fix the bug that The result of 'varbinary + 1' is incorrect
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #23411

Problem Summary:
When a number plus with a string, the result are always a int. In mysql, when string contains real, the result should be a real. 

Tests

- Unit test
- Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)

### Release note 

- Issue Number: close #23411

issue_context.title: The result of 'varbinary + 1' is incorrect
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
```mysql
mysql> create table t1(col1 varbinary(20));
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.38 sec)

mysql> insert into t1 values(".1pingcap");
Query OK, 1 row affected (0.05 sec)

```
<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
```mysql
mysql> select col1, col1 + 1 from t1;
+-----------+----------+
| col1      | col1 + 1 |
+-----------+----------+
| .1pingcap |      1.1 |
+-----------+----------+
1 row in set (0.07 sec)

```
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
```mysql
mysql> select col1, col1 + 1 from t1;
+-----------+----------+
| col1      | col1 + 1 |
+-----------+----------+
| .1pingcap |        1 |
+-----------+----------+
1 row in set (0.06 sec)

```
